accessibility.title: Distributed Forces module introduction static overview
accessibility.long_description: A text-first overview of Distributed Forces. Replace uniform and general distributed loads or fluid-pressure distributions by statically equivalent resultants with correct magnitude, direction, and line of action.

objective: Replace uniform and general distributed loads or fluid-pressure distributions by statically equivalent resultants with correct magnitude, direction, and line of action.
prerequisites: Use force resultants, moments about a reference point, area and centroid ideas, units of load intensity, and pressure variation with depth.

worked_example.entry_description: Adjust a uniform load over a beam interval and compare the load diagram with its area-equivalent resultant located at the distribution centroid.

diagram_description: The planned distributed load and pressure-resultant workspace will support: adjust a uniform load intensity; drag distribution endpoints; edit a piecewise load profile; integrate distribution area; compute distribution centroid; replace distribution with a resultant arrow; adjust fluid depth and density; show hydrostatic pressure profile. Until v1.1.0 is published, this description and procedure map are the complete accessible fallback.
